subject: RE: Coordination: FinTrade global demo during DST mismatch week
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
To: Simon Bauer <simon.bauer@fintrade.de>
Cc: Anna Meyer <anna.meyer@fintrade.de>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Mar 2027 09:15:00 +0100
Subject: Proposed demo slot for FinTrade (global stakeholders)

Hi Simon / Anna —

Thanks again for your time yesterday. We’d love to run a 45-minute product demo next week that includes your trading ops team and our APAC integration lead to cover SSO and data routing. To make it easy across zones, proposed slots (all local times shown below):

- Tue 23 Mar — 10:30 CET / 01:30 PDT / 18:30 SGT
- Wed 24 Mar — 15:00 CET / 06:00 PDT / 21:00 SGT
- Thu 25 Mar — 09:00 CET / 00:00 PDT / 16:00 SGT

Note: US already moved their clocks on Mar 14; Europe’s switch is the last weekend of Mar which falls after these dates. That will create a short period where CET/CEST offsets change — I included both CET and local examples to avoid confusion.

Agenda (attached): 1) quick intro, 2) walkthrough (10m hands-on), 3) SSO + data residency Qs, 4) implementation steps and timeline.

Please let me know which slot works and who from your team will join. If none, we can propose alternate times (I attached an .ics with the three options).

Thanks,
Jordan
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
attachments: fintrade-demo-agenda.pdf (pdf), proposed-times.ics (calendar)
